hardware.renderer: Mesa zink over Vulkan 1.4 / NVK, OpenGL 4.6 core, Mesa 26.2.4
hardware.source: lscpu and native shared OpenGL test context

workload.content: Five partially transparent painted raster layers in one isolated group followed by global Hue/Saturation. Cold means empty raster cache, not application/context startup.

constrained_capacity.status: Unsupported: resource capacity; CPU recovery matched the reference exactly

verification.full_ui_and_adjustment_ui: Passed after stabilizing the existing import cancellation fixture; the request is delivered before queued worker completion, rather than racing a timer against small-image decoding.
verification.native_shared_opengl: Passed parity and worker lifecycle; offscreen shared OpenGL CTest skipped for lack of native context.

baseline_comparison.result: All six known gates failed in the existing pre-HSL binaries before this implementation. The earlier Exposure profile separately records their pre-Exposure source comparison.

known_failures.cause: Invalid timeline zoom returns the wrong error category.
Segmentation fault after export/codec activity. Focused real v23 linked-image producer/consumer gate passes.
Text rasterization exceeds selected alpha ceiling.

verification.additional_cache_fix: A Gradient Map crash reproduced in a clean pre-HSL archive build. The collision regression retained 2048 bytes instead of zero before the QHash erase-iterator fix, passed after it; Gradient Map then passed 30 consecutive runs.

limitations: Single observations, no percentile, speed guarantee or minimum hardware requirement.
CPU and GPU samples were collected in separate runs; other build/regression activity was present during this session.
GPU totals include explicit verification readback. The native context was already initialized by earlier cases.

The same temporary Qt LinguistTools, FFmpeg discovery module/development headers and build-only FF_PROFILE_ to AV_PROFILE_ aliases as the earlier Exposure run were used; no dependencies or app versions were changed here.
Six broader local regression failures remain release blockers, independently of passing new HSL and focused linked-image gates.
Windows/macOS, packaged runtime, owner visual checks and the controlled Windows reference-PC measurements remain pending.
